raw_html: [[Touch of Immortality]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Touch of Immortality]]:''' Passive: While this item is equipped, you gain a +20 [[Competence bonus|Competence Bonus]] to the [[Heal (skill)|Heal]] and [[Repair (skill)|Repair]] skills, and you regenerate 2-4 Hit Points every 15 seconds.
